topic: Computer use in Claude: how to turn it on and what it needs, the safety settings and risks, everyday uses with prompts, and how to schedule recurring tasks
audience: Professionals on a paid Claude plan who use Claude Desktop on a Mac or Windows PC and want Claude to do work in their apps, not just talk about it
goal: Turn on computer use with safe settings, run a first small task in one app, and schedule one recurring task they will check after each run
notes: Computer use lets Claude, when it has no connector or tool for the job, operate your screen directly: clicking, typing and opening apps. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Computer use is available for Pro, Max and Ultra in Cowork and Claude Code in Claude Desktop on macOS and Windows. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

On Team and Enterprise, computer use is a beta that works only in the new Claude experience after an owner turns it on; it doesn't work in tasks started with the 'Cowork' option or in Claude Code. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]
Computer use is not available on Linux. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065433-install-claude-desktop]

Claude picks the most precise tool first: connectors, then the browser, then screen interaction (computer use). [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

To enable: in the desktop app go to Settings > Capabilities (or Settings > System under 'This computer'), turn on 'Enable computer use', then ask Claude for something involving an app; it asks permission for the app. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Claude asks permission before accessing each application; after approval it can keep using that app in that session without asking again. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Access tiers: browsers and many investment, trading and crypto apps are view-only; terminals and code editors allow click and scroll but no typing; most other apps get full access. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Some apps, such as music, video streaming and e-book apps, are off limits, and you can block apps yourself (blocked app requests are automatically denied). [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

On macOS 15 or later Claude works in background windows by default without taking over the pointer; 'Full control' can be chosen under 'How Claude uses the apps you allow'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Claude takes screenshots to navigate; the automated safety check can see the latest screenshot and Anthropic can keep a copy of it in its record of the check. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Computer use is not limited to connected folders, and Cowork's deletion protection does not cover computer use. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Deletion protection: Claude must get your explicit permission (an 'Allow' prompt) before permanently deleting any files; that protection does not cover computer use. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork] [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16761823-claude-cowork-and-chat-are-one-claude]

Cowork runs tasks in the cloud: work happens on Anthropic's servers in an isolated environment, so work continues if you close your laptop. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Anthropic recommends not granting computer use access to sensitive apps (banking, healthcare, government) and starting with simple tasks. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Limitations: the computer must be awake with Claude Desktop open, complex tasks sometimes need a second try, and screen interaction is slower than connectors. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Clicking a link in an approved app can open another app (for example Chrome) even if Claude has no permission for it. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]
On macOS, computer use needs the Accessibility and Screen & System Audio Recording permissions. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18483812-set-up-computer-use-for-team-and-enterprise-plans]

Local file access, browser use and computer use need the Claude Desktop app (macOS or Windows) open and connected, even though sessions run in the cloud; an internet connection is required throughout. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Claude Desktop system requirements: macOS 13 (Ventura) or higher, Windows 10 or higher; but computer use itself requires macOS 14 or later (error message on the computer-use help page). The download page is claude.com/download. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065433-install-claude-desktop] [https://claude.com/download] [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork]

Cowork is available only on paid plans: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise. Pro is $20 a month billed monthly, or $17 a month with the annual discount. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork] [https://claude.com/pricing]

To start a Cowork session: select 'Cowork' in the message box, describe the task, then review Claude's approach and let it run. In the new Claude experience there is no 'Cowork' option: you describe the task in any conversation; you have it if the message box no longer shows 'Chat' and 'Cowork'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork] [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15520349-use-claude-cowork-on-web-desktop-and-mobile]

Approval modes: 'Manually approve' (formerly 'Ask before acting'): Claude pauses for Allow/Deny on actions. 'Automatically approve': Claude keeps working and reviews each action for safety (data exfiltration, prompt injection), blocking unsafe ones; if blocked repeatedly it switches back to asking. 'Skip all approvals' (formerly 'Act without asking'): nothing checks Claude's actions; use only when you completely trust every action, connector, file and app involved. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Anthropic notes the Auto check can miss risky actions; for work involving money, messages sent as you or important files it suggests staying close or switching to Manual. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Switch to 'Manually approve' when a task touches sensitive files, accounts or sites, when using a new tool, plugin or site, or when mistakes would be hard to undo. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]

Prompt injection needs two conditions at once: Claude can read content outside your trust boundary and can take actions that could compromise you. Anthropic states that despite its safety measures the chance of an attack is still non-zero. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]

Advice: watch for unexpected patterns (files or sites you didn't mention, scope creep) rather than validating every command, and stop the task if something feels off. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]

You remain responsible for all actions Claude takes on your behalf, including messages sent, purchases, data modified, scheduled-task actions and computer-use actions. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]

Anthropic advises creating a dedicated working folder for Claude instead of granting broad access, and keeping backups of important files. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]

Multi-step tasks use more usage than a quick question; each step uses tokens. Settings > Usage shows the five-hour and weekly limits. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Scheduled tasks are available on all paid plans (Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise) in Cowork and in the new Claude experience. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13854387-schedule-recurring-tasks-in-claude-cowork]
Type /schedule in any Cowork task, or click 'Scheduled' in the left sidebar, to create and manage scheduled tasks. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

On the Scheduled tasks page, 'New task' offers 'Create with Claude' (Claude asks questions, then you click 'Schedule') or 'Set up manually'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13854387-schedule-recurring-tasks-in-claude-cowork]

The manual 'Create scheduled task' modal asks for a task name, prompt, approval mode, frequency (hourly, daily, weekly, on weekdays, or manually), an optional model and an optional folder. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13854387-schedule-recurring-tasks-in-claude-cowork]

Picking a folder turns on 'Require this computer', so the task runs only while the computer is awake and Claude Desktop is open. Otherwise scheduled tasks run remotely, even when the computer is asleep or Claude Desktop is closed. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13854387-schedule-recurring-tasks-in-claude-cowork]

From the Scheduled page you can view tasks, review upcoming and past runs, edit instructions, cadence and approval mode, pause, resume, delete, or run a task on demand. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13854387-schedule-recurring-tasks-in-claude-cowork]

In the new experience you create a scheduled task by describing it and its frequency in any conversation, then clicking 'Schedule' after reviewing Claude's proposal. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13854387-schedule-recurring-tasks-in-claude-cowork]

Safety advice for scheduled tasks: start simple, avoid sensitive data and hard-to-undo actions, review outputs after each run, and pause tasks you're not using. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]
Cowork can produce Excel spreadsheets with working formulas, PowerPoint presentations and formatted documents. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]
